neighbours.label: function-naming modifier right before an expected device-part noun (heating -> element, processing -> unit, drive -> mechanism) in technical descriptions
fire: The kettle is fitted with a concealed heating element at its base.
Each node contains a graphics processing unit and a network card.
The toaster uses a quartz heating element behind a wire guard.
The printer has a paper feeding mechanism driven by a small motor.
The device comprises a signal processing circuit and an antenna.
The conveyor is powered by a belt drive mechanism beneath the frame.
The sensor includes a light receiving element and a filter.
The lock has a spring-loaded locking mechanism inside the handle.
quiet: The kettle was heating slowly while we set the table.
Each farmer was processing apples and loading a cart.
The toaster sat behind a wire rack on the shelf.
The printer was feeding on cheap ink, the manager joked.
They kept processing claims until the office closed.
We went for a long drive along the coast.
The crowd was receiving the news with a cheer.
She was locking the gate when the rain began.

notes: Probes: 'ceramic heating [element]' 0.78, 'light-emitting' 0.51, 'central processing [unit]' 0.45, 'drive [mechanism]' 0.35, 'image recording [mechanism]' 0.16; the same -ing words as verbs 0.00-0.01. The output direction promotes ' unit' / ' element' / ' assembly'.
